evidence: Reachability. Runtime: environment/Dockerfile installs node:22, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 under NODE_PATH; everything the brief needs (sessions, password check via crypto, polling/SSE live updates, SQLite durability, static UI) is buildable with those plus Node built-ins; hireops_rules.md:129 explicitly allows polling or SSE so no websocket package is needed; the browser may use CDNs (instruction.md:15, integration.md:12-14) and network is public. Seed: seed_data.json has the 10 users matching instruction.md:19 and app_context.md, 3 jobs with interview_limit, 16 applications with stage/position (APP-301 carries rejected_from/reject_reason), 127 messages (APP-101 has 120 with strictly increasing unique timestamps, so 'counted from its first' read markers are unambiguous), 3 notes, 6 read markers, candidate_status_labels and thread_page_size=30 (hireops_rules.md:213-218). The password is in the brief (instruction.md:19, hireops_rules.md:11). Every seeded fact a criterion quotes re-derives from the seed: Platform Engineer Applied Greta/Ade/Marco, Screen Priya/Samuel and Noor's note (hro_intake_restart); Lena's unread 1 = 3 APP-301 messages minus read_count 2 (hro_unread_seen); Noor Interviewing / Application received and Tomas In review (hro_candidate). Launch contract: test.sh:104-111 runs node under env -i with PATH/NODE_PATH/HOME/PORT=3000/DB_PATH as uid 65534, possibly from a writable copy, which hireops_rules.md:205-211 and integration.md:16-23 disclose; the symlink rule enforced at test.sh:71-82 is disclosed at integration.md:16-19; 'start with no shipped database' (instruction.md:17) is stated, which matters because test.sh does not delete /app/app.db. restart_app exists (restart_mcp.py) for the restart legs. Achievability is also shown by the reference: the solution requires only express, better-sqlite3 and node built-ins, and the hash-verified scripted golden results (workspace.json, 26 groups against the frozen solution bytes) pass the board, undo, bulk, roles, unread/seen, paging and candidate-privacy groups; that is scripted golden evidence, not a configured judge run, Oracle or model score. Single reading / no hidden requirement (lessons 1 and 12). I mapped every graded leg of all 15 functional, 5 polish and 2 gate criteria to a public sentence: places whole 1-50 (rules:29) for 0/51/2.5; manager picked from hiring-manager accounts (rules:29-30); case-insensitive duplicate email with field error and kept input (rules:33-36); one-stage moves and refused skips (rules:48-49); reject reason and reopen-to-rejected-from clearing the reason (rules:49-51); bottom placement and ordinary-control re-order (rules:57-60); Interview cap and re-order inside a full Interview (rules:64-66); 409 naming who (rules:78-82); optimistic move put back with reason and focus (rules:86-88); bulk board-order arrival and all-or-nothing (rules:92-95); undo incl. reject/reopen, own latest only, blocked by any change, overfill, single use, note not a change (rules:99-104); activity lines incl. undo and reason, newest first, job filter, refused leaves no line (rules:115-119); 15 s live updates incl. unread and seen marks with typing/focus/open card/scroll preserved (rules:123-129); role matrix and 401/403/404 (rules:22-24, 70-74, 137-141); Enter/Shift+Enter, plain text, empty focused box, failed send kept (rules:145-147); 30-message paging with remaining count and anchored place (rules:151-154); unread/seen definitions incl. observer exclusion (rules:158-173); per-user per-conversation reply drafts surviving switch, reload and session end with re-sign-in (rules:177-182) and note drafts (rules:110-111); candidate wording and privacy fields (rules:186-203). Gate legs (wrong password stays signed out; session survives reload; Observer sees a recruiter-added card) follow directly from the sign-in and shared-board statements. No criterion needs a golden-only route, label, colour or wording; app_context.md:37-38 and functional prompt.md 'Requests and replays' forbid assuming reference routes and let un-offered forms (reopen taking no stage, one-step-only move controls) pass when the card is unchanged and the allowed action succeeded. Second readings checked and found harmless or ungraded (Notes, not defects): (a) whether a within-stage re-order is itself an undoable 'move' that supersedes the previous one is not stated (rules:99 names only reject/reopen as counting); no criterion depends on it, because hro_undo, hro_interview_places and hro_activity always make a stage move after any self re-order before undoing. (b) 'the place it came from' as index vs neighbour: every graded undo (V to top of Applied; Y,W,X back before Z,A2; C to top of Applied; A2 into an empty Applied) gives the same result under both readings. (c) A candidate writing in another candidate's conversation: general 403 rule (rules:23) vs candidate-specific 404 rule (rules:24); hro_messaging requires 404 for Noor's send replay and hro_candidate 404 for the read, but the specific rule names candidates and its stated reason ('so they can't even learn that it's there') applies equally to writes, so there is one reasonable reading; hro_readonly_roles already accepts 403 or 404 for Tomas. (d) Bulk move to Rejected, or including a card already in the target stage, is unspecified but ungraded. (e) The self-check line (instruction.md:13, lesson 5) mentions 'separate browsers' though the agent image ships no browser; it is advisory and ungraded and can be done with two cookie sessions, so it is not an unreachable graded item. (f) 'Blank title refused' is implied by 'A job has a title' (rules:28) rather than stated verbatim; a reasonable builder reaches it. Counterexample attempts: a conforming-looking app that checks staleness by expected from-stage instead of a version would pass the A-B-A replay in hro_two_people, but rules:78-80 explicitly require a per-card version that changes on every move, so that alternative is non-conforming rather than a second reading. A broken app cannot exploit any of the ambiguities above because each graded refusal needs a positive control (functional prompt.md 'Requests and replays'). No unreachable item and no ambiguity that changes a graded outcome was found. Missing configured-judge/Oracle evidence is outside this row and is not waived by this Pass.
